description: This file contains React hooks for managing search suggestions in the Mattermost web application, including fetching suggestions based on user input and handling selection state.

methods.name: useSearchSuggestions
methods.description: React hook that provides search suggestions based on input parameters, managing suggestion providers and updating results.

methods.name: useSearchSuggestionSelection
methods.description: React hook that manages the selection state of search suggestion results, allowing navigation and clearing of selection.
